mapper.sql: select s.schedule_id, s.activity_id, s.topic_id, s.schedule_name, s.schedule_date, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.duration_min, s.speaker_names, s.host_names, s.discuss_names, s.sort_order, s.del_flag, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, t.topic_name, t.venue_id, v.venue_name from yc_schedule s left join yc_topic t on t.topic_id=s.topic_id and t.del_flag='0' left join yc_venue v on v.venue_id=t.venue_id and v.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: where s.del_flag='0' and s.activity_id=#{activityId} order by s.start_time asc, s.schedule_id asc
select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(ifnull(duration_min,0)),0) as totalDuration from yc_schedule where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_schedule set del_flag='2' where schedule_id in #{id}
